title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
summary: Startup founders and AI industry leaders are urging the Trump administration not to restrict Chinese open-weight AI models like DeepSeek, warning that such restrictions could harm American startups and developers who depend on these freely available models for innovation and cost efficiency.
problem_solved: This content addresses the policy debate around whether the U.S. should restrict access to Chinese open-weight AI models amid geopolitical tensions.
why_valuable: It provides critical insight into how open-weight AI models have become essential infrastructure for startups and how policy restrictions could backfire by limiting American competitiveness.
